manifest.name: dsh-yizi-themes
manifest.description: YiziMarkdown theme pack for DeepSeek Harness — 19 style themes, Theme Studio custom themes, custom brand, WCAG contrast checks and config transfer.

scripts.verify: node scripts/typecheck.mjs && node scripts/self-check.mjs && node scripts/hot-reload-check.mjs && node prepare.mjs

manifest.author: laoduu

bundle.text:
# YiziThemes bundle patch: inserts the theme pack into the Web UI composition.
# The plugin row references this package by name; the profile loader resolves
# it from node_modules (installed via `dsh plugin --profile <name> add`).
- insert:
    - id: yizi-themes
      name: dsh-yizi-themes
      config:
        # Default brand values; users can override these in their cordis.patch.yml.
        wordmark: 'DEEPSEEK'
        wordmarkBadge: 'HARNESS'
        headline: '探索未至之境'
        mappingEnabled: false
        mappingDeepSeek: 'DeepSeek'
        mappingDeepSeekChinese: '深度求索'
        mappingHarness: 'Harness'
        mappingDeepSeekHarness: 'DeepSeek Harness'

readme.text: <div align="center">

**19 个精品风格主题 + 自定义品牌 for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web UI**

完整移植自 [YiziMarkdown](https://github.com/laoduu/YiziMarkdown) 的设计语言，
为 Harness 的 `--dsw-alias-*` 语义 token 体系量身定制。

**学术蓝 · 极光 · 赛博朋克 · Facebook · 液态玻璃 · 荔枝红 · 杂志感 · 黑客帝国 · 极简风 · 薄荷冰沙 · 莫兰迪 · 自然风 · 故宫朱砂 · 落日熔金 · 科技感 · 复古打字机 · 蒸汽波 · 活力橙 · 紫罗兰**

每个主题都同时支持 **亮色 / 深色** 两套配色，并跟随你的「浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统」设置。

标准 **Cordis 插件**：`dsh plugin` 一键安装，不改动 Harness 源码。
[English](README.en.md) · [安装教程](#-安装教程) · [自定义品牌](#-自定义品牌) · [版本日志](CHANGELOG.md) · [开发日志](docs/DEVLOG.md) · [Agent 安装指引](docs/AGENT-SKILL.md) ---

- 🎭 **19 个主题**：从极光流光到赛博朋克霓虹，从莫兰迪高级灰到故宫朱砂，总有一款配得上你的审美
- 🌈 **主题工作室 · 自定义主题**（0.5.6）：只选一个主题色，完整明暗两套配色**自动派生**（主色 / 墨色 / 底色浓度 / 描边风格 / 字号五个声部各自遵循预设手工调校的规律），卡片实时预览，保存后立刻出现在主题网格、选择器和 `/theme` 里（设置 → 外观 → 自定义主题）
- 🎚️ **高级调色**（0.5.6）：想自己动手时，可覆盖墨色、底色浓度、描边风格（品牌色 / 中性墨）与明暗底色；留空即自动，不必懂 OKLCH
- 🌗 **双模式**：每个主题都有精心调配的亮色 / 深色两套 token，跟随系统自动切换
- 🧩 **标准插件**：标准 Cordis 插件（`dsh plugin` 安装/卸载），不修改 Harness 仓库任何源码
- ✅ **干净 Harness 开箱即用**：风格主题由插件自实现（含持久化与 `body.theme-<id>` 应用），无需给 Harness 打任何补丁
- 🧩 **升级免疫（官方槽位）**：品牌（左上角 Logo / 字样 / 徽章 / 新会话标题）通过 Harness 官方品牌槽位渲染（`sidebar.brand.mark` / `sidebar.brand.name` / `conversation.hero.brand.mark`），并以更低 `priority` 注册，与标准构建自带的官方品牌插件共存且本插件生效；无槽位的旧核心自动回退到原 viewBox 注入路径
- 🧱 **本代适配（0.5.2）**：适配 `dsh-client-store` / `configForms` 一代（Harness ≥ `v0.1.2-alpha.1`，含 `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-rc.2` / `0.2.1-rc.3` 桌面版）；自定义品牌持久化在浏览器本地（`localStorage`），不依赖 Harness 的设置传输层
- 🎚️ **正交双维度**：明暗模式与风格主题完全独立，可自由组合
- 🖌️ **自定义品牌**：左上角 Logo / 品牌字样 / 徽章 / 新会话标题全部可自定义，**颜色自动跟随主题与明暗**
- 📐 **品牌尺寸可调**（0.5.4）：左上角 Logo、品牌字样、徽章按同一倍率**整体缩放**（75%–200%，设置 → **主题外观** → 自定义 → 品牌尺寸），拖动即时生效、无需重启
- 🔤 **品牌映射**（实验性，默认关闭）：把界面/输出中出现的 "DeepSeek / 深度求索 / Harness" 替换为你设定的品牌词（开启后也绝不改写你正在输入的内容）

readme.section: 方式一：从 GitHub Release 下载 tgz（推荐）
readme.text:
1. 下载 `dsh-yizi-themes-0.5.8.tgz` —— 在 [Releases 页面](https://github.com/laoduu/DeepSeek-Harness-yizi-themes/releases) 点击下载，或直接命令行拉取：

```bash
curl -L -o dsh-yizi-themes-0.5.8.tgz https://github.com/laoduu/DeepSeek-Harness-yizi-themes/releases/download/v0.5.8/dsh-yizi-themes-0.5.8.tgz
```

2. 停掉正在运行的 `dsh web`（Ctrl+C）；
3. 安装：

```bash
cd <你的 deepseek-harness 路径>
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-yizi-themes-0.5.8.tgz
```

readme.section: 方式一：从 GitHub Release 下载 tgz（推荐）
readme.text:
> 💡 **桌面版（DSH Desktop App）用户**：把 `--profile web` 换成 `--profile desktop`，
> 安装到桌面版自己的 profile（`$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop`）——web 与桌面版是两个独立 profile，互不相通。

4. 重启：

```bash
pnpm dsh web
```
```bash

git clone https://github.com/laoduu/DeepSeek-Harness-yizi-themes.git

readme.section: 构建并打包（prepare.mjs 从 Harness 仓库的 node_modules 解析 tsdown）
readme.text:
node prepare.mjs
npm pack          # 产出 dsh-yizi-themes-<version>.tgz
```

然后按方式一的 2-4 步安装、重启。

readme.section: ⚠️ 更新已有安装（同版本陷阱）
readme.text:
**同版本 tgz 内容变了，直接 `add` 不会更新**（pnpm 报 `Already up to date`）。

- 版本号**变了**：直接 `add` 即可；
- 版本号**没变**：必须先卸载再安装：

```bash
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-yizi-themes
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add  /path/to/dsh-yizi-themes-<version>.tgz
```

- **切换主题 / 明暗**：右上角调色板按钮 + 明暗切换按钮（会话头部）；新会话（无对话内容）时以浮动按钮显示在同一位置；也可以直接敲 `/theme`；
- **自己做主题**：设置 → **主题外观** → **自定义主题**——填名称、选主题色，卡片实时预览，点「添加主题」保存；已存主题带「应用 / 编辑 / 删除」，全部即时生效，无需重启（详见下节）；
- **自定义品牌**：设置 → **主题外观** → 自定义（见下节）。

---

readme.section: 🌈 主题工作室（自定义主题）
readme.text:
设置 → **主题外观** → **自定义主题**：

| 步骤 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 1. 填名称 | 如「海之蓝」「樱花粉」（同名同色重复添加只会覆盖原主题，不会堆出多个） |
| 2. 选主题色 | 一个就行——明暗两套完整配色自动派生 |
| 3. 预览 | 卡片实时展示该配色在界面上的样子 |
| 4. 添加主题 | 立刻出现在上方主题网格、右上角选择器和 `/theme` 里 |

**高级调色**（可选，展开后可见）：想自己动手时，可覆盖

| 声部 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| **墨色** | 第二色相：文字、Toast 与深色页面的底色都跟随它（蓝色品牌默认自动 +43° 偏紫，与预设一致） |
| **底色浓度** | 背景染色的强度，越大越"有颜色" |
| **描边风格** | `品牌色`（彩色描边）或 `中性墨`（中性灰描边） |
| **亮底 / 暗底** | 直接指定明暗模式的页面底色 |

任何字段留空即保持自动推导。保存后仍可再次「编辑」，删除即时生效。

readme.section: 🌈 主题工作室（自定义主题）
readme.text:
**对比度实时检查**（0.5.7）：编辑时下方实时给出四组 WCAG 2.1 对比度——品牌 / 亮底、文字 / 亮底、品牌 / 暗底、文字 / 暗底——并标注 AAA（≥7:1）/ AA（≥4.5:1）/ 仅大字号（≥3:1）/ 不达标。已存主题列表的徽标取其中**最差**的一组，鼠标悬停可看具体关系与分值。配色好不好看是主观的，能不能读有客观数字。

---

设置 → **主题外观** → **配置备份**：把「自定义主题 + 品牌设置」整体导出为 JSON，或从 JSON 导入。

| 场景 | 用法 |
|---|---|
| **换浏览器 / 换设备** | 旧环境「导出 JSON」→ 新环境「导入 JSON」 |
| **Web 版 ↔ 桌面版搬家** | 两个 profile 的 localStorage 互不相通，用这条路径搬运 |
| **改主题前留个底** | 导出即备份，改坏了导入回来 |
| **把主题包发给别人** | 别人导入你的 JSON 就能用上同一套主题 + 品牌 |

导入规则：**按 id 合并**——同名主题被覆盖更新（不会堆出重复项），新主题追加到列表末尾；文件里的品牌设置与当前主题一起应用。缺字段、坏条目的部分会被跳过并提示，不会整份失败。

也可以在输入框敲 `/theme`，在弹出的菜单底部用「随机换一个主题 / 导入配置 / 导出配置」三行操作。

---

设置 → **主题外观** → **自定义** 板块：

| 设置项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **Logo SVG** | 粘贴 SVG 代码或 data URI。用于**左上角品牌、收起侧边栏图标、新会话页图标**三处。留空用内置鲸鱼标 |
| **品牌字样** | 左上角品牌文字（默认 `DEEPSEEK`，基准 18px，随品牌尺寸缩放） |
| **徽章字样** | 品牌文字旁的徽章标签（默认 `HARNESS`） |
| **新会话标题** | 新会话页标题文案（默认 `探索未至之境`） |
| **品牌尺寸** | 滑块整体缩放左上角 Logo、品牌字样与徽章（75%–200%，默认 100%），拖动即时生效、无需重启；放大时侧边栏品牌行自动留出空间，不会裁切 |
| **品牌映射** | 开关（默认关闭，实验性）+ 映射表：把界面/输出中出现的 "DeepSeek Harness / DeepSeek / 深度求索 / Harness" 替换为设定词；**代码块、终端输出与输入框内容不会被改写**（那里它们是数据，不是品牌） |

**颜色自动跟随主题**：品牌字样、徽章背景、Logo 容器颜色统一使用 `--dsw-alias-brand-primary`，
切换任意风格主题或明暗模式时自动变化。

> **想让自己的 SVG 也跟随主题？** 把 SVG 里的硬编码颜色替换为：
> - `fill="var(--dsw-alias-brand-primary)"` —— 随主题与明暗自动切换；
> - `fill="currentColor"` —— 继承容器颜色（容器已设为主题色）。
>
> 其他可用变量：主文字 `--dsw-alias-label-primary`、次要文字 `--dsw-alias-label-secondary` /
> `--dsw-alias-label-caption`、反色文字 `--dsw-alias-label-primary-inverted`、
> 背景 `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1`、边框 `--dsw-alias-border-l1` 等。

**持久化**：所有品牌设置（含品牌尺寸 `scale`）保存在**浏览器本地**（`localStorage` 键 `dsh-yizi-themes:brand`），
桌面版与 Web 版、不同浏览器各存各的，重启不丢失。

---

插件行的默认配置（可在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖）：

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `wordmark` | `DEEPSEEK` | 品牌字样 |
| `wordmarkBadge` | `HARNESS` | 徽章字样 |
| `headline` | `探索未至之境` | 新会话标题 |
| `mappingEnabled` | `false` | 是否启用品牌映射 |
| `mappingDeepSeek` / `mappingDeepSeekChinese` / `mappingHarness` / `mappingDeepSeekHarness` | 原文 | 各品牌词的替换目标 |

设置页的修改优先级高于此配置（配置作为 base 层，用户层覆盖之）。

---

```bash
cd <你的 deepseek-harness 路径>
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-yizi-themes
```

重启 `dsh web` 即恢复默认外观。`settings.yaml` 里的 `ui-theme.customBrand` 属于核心命名空间，
卸载后仍保留（无副作用，可手工删除）。

---

**Q: 更新后界面没变化？**
版本号没变则必须 `remove → add`（见上）；并完全重启 `dsh web`（Ctrl+C 后重启）+ 浏览器强刷 Ctrl+Shift+R。

**Q: 设置能输入但刷新后丢失？**
0.5.0 起自定义品牌与风格主题持久化在**浏览器本地**（`localStorage`：`dsh-yizi-themes:brand` / `dsh-yizi-themes:themeId`），不再写入 `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`。若刷新后丢失：确认不是隐私/无痕模式（localStorage 可能被禁用）；桌面版与 Web 版各存各的，互不同步。

**Q: 切换主题后左上角品牌颜色不变？**
确认 Logo/品牌字样已设置且为 `currentColor` 或 `var(--dsw-alias-brand-primary)`；硬编码颜色不会跟随主题。

**Q: 侧边栏折叠后重新展开空白？**
老版本 bug，升级到 0.2.2+。

**Q: 装上插件后 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 起不来？**
0.4.0 及更早的客户端 bundle 仍 `require('@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime/client')`，而该包在 `dsh-client-store` 一代已被**整包删除**——桌面版的 web 引导是"任一 entry 激活失败即整体中止"，所以应用直接黑屏/打不开。0.5.0 已改用本代平台模块（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`）并适配收窄后的 `ui-theme` schema。
已经装坏、界面进不去时：命令行执行 `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-yizi-themes`（不需要打开界面），再完全退出并重启桌面版即可恢复；然后升级到最新版（当前 0.5.7）重新安装。

**Q: 装上插件后启动失败（`web boot: 1 entry did not activate` / `dsh-yizi-themes: failed`）？**
0.5.6 起插件**不会再让启动失败**：apply 的每个阶段都隔离兜底、插槽注册幂等，被重复加载（热重载 / 组合重载）也照常工作。若仍看到该报错，说明装的是 0.5.5 及更早版本（旧包在启动早期抛错会中止整个客户端引导）——`remove` 后重装 0.5.6 即可。
排查任何异常：浏览器 F12 → Application → Local Storage → `dsh-yizi-themes:bootlog`（最近 60 条启动轨迹，每阶段 `ok:` / `FAIL:`），`FAIL:` 一行就是根因所在阶段。

**Q: 装好能启动，但整个界面样式错乱 / 控件变形 / 主题点了没反应？**
0.5.6 已修（暗色配色推导里一个未声明变量会让整张样式表不发射，导致预设主题、行布局、品牌规则全部缺失）。确认版本 ≥ 0.5.6；若仍出现，同样看 `dsh-yizi-themes:bootlog` 里的 `FAIL:` 行。

**Q: 干净 Harness（官方源码 / npm 发布的 rc.5）能用吗？**
0.5.x 面向 `dsh-client-store` 一代（Harness ≥ `v0.1.2-alpha.1`，含 `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-rc.2` 桌面版）；更老的 rc.5 / rc.8 请用 0.3.x。风格主题一直由插件自实现（`localStorage` 持久化 + 自行切换 `body.theme-<id>`），无需给核心打任何补丁；明暗切换仍走核心 `ctx.theme`。

**Q: 控制台报 `single slot "sidebar.brand.mark" already has a registration at priority 0`？**
旧版本以默认 priority 0 注册品牌槽位，与标准构建自带的官方品牌插件（`dsh-client-ui-brand-official`）撞车——single 槽位不允许同优先级的第二个占用者（报错里的 "registered by X" 指的是**已存在的**那个）。0.5.0 起本插件以 `priority: -100` 注册（single 槽位渲染最低优先级者），两者共存且本插件品牌生效。

**Q: Harness 升级到 v0.1.0-rc.8 后，自定义品牌失效了？**
0.3.x 起已适配。rc.8 把侧边栏品牌从单个 `BrandWordmark`（`viewBox="0 0 182 24"`）改成了官方品牌槽位（`sidebar.brand.mark` / `sidebar.brand.name` / `conversation.hero.brand.mark`）。插件改为注册这些槽位来渲染自定义 Logo / 字样 / 徽章 / 新会话标题——槽位是官方扩展面，**后续 Harness 升级只要保留槽位契约即可继续工作**；无槽位的旧核心自动回退到原 viewBox 注入路径。升级后若仍显示旧版，请先 `remove` 再 `add`（同版本内容变了 pnpm 会报 "Already up to date"）。

**Q: Harness 升级到 v0.1.2-alpha.1 后，插件启动报 `dsh-client-runtime` missed the module table？**
官方在新版移除了 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` 包，旧版插件（0.3.x）仍引用它导致加载失败。**升级到 0.4.0 及以上（当前最新 0.5.7）**（已迁移到 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store` / `@deepseek-ai/cordis`）。若你已安装 0.3.x，先 `remove` 再 `add` 最新版，并完全重启 `dsh web`（Ctrl+C 后重启）+ 浏览器强刷 Ctrl+Shift+R。

**Q: 想让 agent 帮我装插件？**
把 [Agent 安装指引](docs/AGENT-SKILL.md) 交给 agent 即可。

readme.section: Option 1: Download the tgz from GitHub Releases (recommended)
readme.text:
1. Download `dsh-yizi-themes-0.5.8.tgz` — from the [Releases page](https://github.com/laoduu/DeepSeek-Harness-yizi-themes/releases), or straight from the CLI:

```bash
curl -L -o dsh-yizi-themes-0.5.8.tgz https://github.com/laoduu/DeepSeek-Harness-yizi-themes/releases/download/v0.5.8/dsh-yizi-themes-0.5.8.tgz
```

2. Stop the running `dsh web` (Ctrl+C);
3. Install:

```bash
cd <your deepseek-harness path>
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-yizi-themes-0.5.8.tgz
```

readme.section: Option 1: Download the tgz from GitHub Releases (recommended)
readme.text:
> 💡 **DSH Desktop App users**: use `--profile desktop` instead — the desktop app
> and the web profile are separate profiles (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<desktop|web>`),
> plugin installs do not cross over.

4. Restart:

```bash
pnpm dsh web
```

```bash
git clone https://github.com/laoduu/DeepSeek-Harness-yizi-themes.git
cd DeepSeek-Harness-yizi-themes

node prepare.mjs    # prepare.mjs resolves tsdown from the Harness checkout

Then follow Option 1 steps 2–4.

Re-`add` of a tarball with the **same version** does nothing (pnpm says `Already up to date`).

- Version **changed**: a plain `add` works.
- Version **unchanged**: remove first, then add:

```bash
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-yizi-themes
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add  /path/to/dsh-yizi-themes-<version>.tgz
```

- **Switch theme / mode**: the palette button + light/dark toggle at the top right of the session header; on a blank new session they appear as floating controls in the same spot. Typing `/theme` works too.
- **Make your own theme**: Settings → **Appearance** → **Custom theme** — name it, pick an accent, preview it live, then press "Add theme". Saved themes have Apply / Edit / Delete, all applied instantly with no restart (see below).
- **Custom branding**: Settings → **Appearance** → Custom (below).

Settings → **Appearance** → **Custom theme**:

| Step | What it does |
|---|---|
| 1. Name it | e.g. "Ocean Blue" — adding the same name + colour again overwrites that theme instead of stacking duplicates |
| 2. Pick an accent | One colour is enough — complete light and dark palettes are derived from it |
| 3. Preview | The card renders that palette live |
| 4. Add theme | It appears immediately in the theme grid, the top-right pickers and `/theme` |

**Advanced palette** (optional, collapsible): take control of

| Voice | Effect |
|---|---|
| **Ink** | The second hue: text, toasts and the dark page follow it (a blue brand drifts its ink +43° toward violet by default, matching the presets) |
| **Tint strength** | How strongly backgrounds are tinted |
| **Border voice** | `Brand` (coloured chrome) or `Neutral ink` (neutral grey chrome) |
| **Light / dark base** | Pin either page background colour directly |

Leave any field empty to stay automatic. Saved themes can be edited again, and deletion is instant.

**Live contrast checking** (0.5.7): while you edit, the studio shows four WCAG 2.1 ratios — brand/light, text/light, brand/dark, text/dark — rated AAA (≥7:1) / AA (≥4.5:1) / large-only (≥3:1) / fail. The badge on each saved theme reports its **weakest** pair; hover it for the exact relationship and value. Whether a palette looks good is a matter of taste; whether it is readable has a number.

---
Settings → **Appearance** → **Settings backup**: export "custom themes + brand settings" as one JSON file, or import it back.

| Situation | How |
|---|---|
| **New browser / new machine** | Export from the old environment, import in the new one |
| **Moving from web to desktop (or back)** | The two profiles have separate localStorage; this is the bridge |
| **Before editing a theme** | Export is a backup; import to roll back |
| **Sharing a theme pack** | Whoever imports your JSON gets the same themes and brand |

Imports **merge by id**: a theme with the same id is updated in place (no duplicates), new themes are appended, and the file's brand settings plus selected theme are applied. Missing fields and broken entries are skipped with a notice instead of failing the whole file.

You can also type `/theme` and use the action rows at the bottom of the popup: random theme, import settings, export settings.

---

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| **Logo SVG** | Paste SVG markup or a data URI. Used for the **top-left brand, the collapsed sidebar icon, and the new-session page icon**. Leave empty for the built-in whale mark |
| **Wordmark** | Top-left brand text (default `DEEPSEEK`, 18px base, scales with Brand size) |
| **Badge** | Small badge next to the wordmark (default `HARNESS`) |
| **Headline** | New-session page headline (default `探索未至之境`) |
| **Brand size** | One slider scaling the top-left logo, wordmark and badge together (75%–200%, default 100%); applied live, no restart — the sidebar brand row grows to fit, so nothing gets clipped |
| **Brand mappings** | Toggle (off by default, experimental) + mapping table replacing "DeepSeek Harness / DeepSeek / 深度求索 / Harness" on reading surfaces; **code blocks, terminal output and input fields are never rewritten** — there those strings are data, not branding |

**Colors follow the theme automatically**: wordmark, badge background, and the logo container all use
`--dsw-alias-brand-primary`, so they change with any style theme and light/dark mode.

> **Want your own SVG to follow the theme too?** Replace hardcoded colors in the SVG with:
> - `fill="var(--dsw-alias-brand-primary)"` — follows theme and light/dark automatically;
> - `fill="currentColor"` — inherits the container color (already set to the theme color).
>
> Other tokens: primary text `--dsw-alias-label-primary`, secondary `--dsw-alias-label-secondary` /
> `--dsw-alias-label-caption`, inverted text `--dsw-alias-label-primary-inverted`,
> background `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1`, border `--dsw-alias-border-l1`, etc.

**Persistence**: all branding settings (including the brand `scale`) live in **browser-local storage**
(`localStorage` key `dsh-yizi-themes:brand`) — desktop and web, and each browser, store their own copy;
survives restarts.

---

Default plugin-row config (overridable in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`):

| Field | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `wordmark` | `DEEPSEEK` | Brand wordmark |
| `wordmarkBadge` | `HARNESS` | Badge text |
| `headline` | `探索未至之境` | New-session headline |
| `mappingEnabled` | `false` | Enable brand-string replacement |
| `mappingDeepSeek` / `mappingDeepSeekChinese` / `mappingHarness` / `mappingDeepSeekHarness` | original | Replacement targets |

Settings-page edits take precedence over this config (config seeds the base layer; the user layer overrides it).

cd <your deepseek-harness path>
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-yizi-themes
```

Restart `dsh web` to restore the default appearance. `ui-theme.customBrand` belongs to the core
namespace and remains after uninstall (harmless; remove manually if you like).

**Q: Nothing changed after updating?**
If the version did not change you must `remove → add` (see above), fully restart `dsh web` (Ctrl+C), and hard-refresh the browser (Ctrl+Shift+R).

**Q: Settings accept input but are lost after refresh?**
Since 0.5.0 custom branding and style themes persist in **browser-local storage** (`localStorage`: `dsh-yizi-themes:brand` / `dsh-yizi-themes:themeId`) and no longer touch `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`. If values are lost after refresh: make sure you are not in private/incognito mode (localStorage may be disabled); desktop and web store data **independently** (not synced).

**Q: Top-left brand color does not follow the theme?**
Make sure the logo/wordmark is set and uses `currentColor` or `var(--dsw-alias-brand-primary)`; hardcoded colors never adapt.

**Q: Blank sidebar after collapse/expand?**
Old bug — upgrade to 0.2.2+.

**Q: DeepSeek Harness Desktop won't start after installing the plugin?**
Versions ≤ 0.4.0 still `require`d `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime/client`, and that package was **deleted** in the `dsh-client-store` generation. The desktop web bootstrap is all-or-nothing — one entry failing to activate aborts the whole client boot — so the app blank-screens. 0.5.0 moves to the current platform module (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`) and adapts to the narrowed `ui-theme` schema.
If it is already broken and the UI won't open: run `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-yizi-themes` from a terminal (no GUI needed), fully quit and restart the desktop app, then install the latest release (0.5.6).
Since 0.5.6 the plugin can no longer fail the boot at all: every apply stage is isolated and every slot registration is idempotent, so a second load (hot reload, composition reload) is harmless. A `web boot: 1 entry did not activate` / `dsh-yizi-themes: failed` line therefore means a build older than 0.5.6 — `remove` and reinstall.

**Q: It starts but the whole UI is unstyled / controls are deformed / themes do nothing?**
Fixed in 0.5.6: an undeclared variable in the dark palette derivation made the entire stylesheet fail to emit (preset themes, row layout and brand rules all vanished). Make sure you are on 0.5.6+; if it still happens, check `dsh-yizi-themes:bootlog` in localStorage (F12 → Application → Local Storage) — the `FAIL:` line names the stage.

**Q: Does it work on stock Harness (official source / npm-published rc.5)?**
0.5.x targets the `dsh-client-store` generation (Harness ≥ `v0.1.2-alpha.1`, including the `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-rc.2` desktop apps); older rc.5 / rc.8 cores should use 0.3.x. Style themes have always been implemented by the plugin itself (`localStorage` + `body.theme-<id>`), so no core patch is needed; light/dark still goes through the core `ctx.theme`.

**Q: Console reports `single slot "sidebar.brand.mark" already has a registration at priority 0`?**
Older builds registered the brand slots at the default priority 0, colliding with the stock official brand plugin (`dsh-client-ui-brand-official`) — a single slot rejects a second occupant at the same priority (the "registered by X" in the message names the **existing** occupant). Since 0.5.0 the plugin registers at `priority: -100`; a single slot renders its lowest-priority occupant, so both coexist and the plugin's branding wins.

**Q: Custom branding stopped working after upgrading Harness to v0.1.0-rc.8?**
Adapted since 0.3.x (starting 0.3.0). rc.8 replaced the sidebar's single `BrandWordmark` (`viewBox="0 0 182 24"`) with official brand slots (`sidebar.brand.mark` / `sidebar.brand.name` / `conversation.hero.brand.mark`). The plugin registers those slots to render the custom logo / wordmark / badge / new-session headline — the slots are the official extension surface, so **future Harness upgrades keep working as long as the slot contract survives**; cores without the slots fall back to the old viewBox injection path automatically. If a same-version reinstall is ignored ("Already up to date"), `remove` then `add`.

**Q: After upgrading Harness to v0.1.2-alpha.1 the plugin fails with `dsh-client-runtime` missed the module table?**
New Harness builds removed the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` package, which the old plugin (0.3.x) still references — hence the load failure. **Upgrade to 0.4.0 or later (latest is 0.5.6)** (migrated to `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store` / `@deepseek-ai/cordis`). If you have 0.3.x installed, `remove` first, then `add` the latest release, fully restart `dsh web` (Ctrl+C) and hard-refresh the browser (Ctrl+Shift+R).
